focus_details.name: Essential Properties Realty Trust

key_dates.note: Beats EPS by 5.77%; EquipmentShare (3.5% ABR) alleged fraud
Watch: acquisition pace, car wash ABR trend, AFFO/share guidance

thesis_points: Acquisition flywheel: relationship-driven bilateral sourcing → 8.16% cap rate, 18.7yr WALT, 2.2% annual bumps → 10.0% GAAP yield vs peers' 7–8%
88% of H1 2025 deployments came from existing tenants — tenant-growth pipeline, not cyclical opportunism
Tenant risk is overpriced: ZIPS bankruptcy was a balance-sheet failure, not demand destruction; car wash same-store sales resilient through recessions
Portfolio: 2,261 properties, 48 states, 99% occupancy, 51% Sunbelt ABR, 400+ tenants (no one >4% ABR), 3.4x rent coverage
Revenue: 77.6% service-based (car washes, medical/dental, childcare, QSR) — insulated from e-commerce disruption
$250–370M deployed per quarter at ~8% cash cap / ~10% GAAP cap regardless of implied spread noise

key_debate.street: Unrated middle-market tenants (~97% of deals) are too risky; car wash ~14% ABR introduces cyclical risk after ZIPS bankruptcy
key_debate.our_view: Granular diversification (400+ tenants, no one >4% ABR) + 18yr WALT + 2% escalators + master lease protection offset unrated tenant risk. Car wash fears are misunderstood

risks: Competitive pressure on cap rates from PE/family offices
